737:t_127:5.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「They're the enemy of us... of all life!」

737:t_127:6.en:
$$シン$$
「I'll show you, $$御使い$$! The power born from the small lives you look down on!」

737:t_127:7.en:
$$シン$$
「I will never forgive war, or those who create it! I will never forgive you!!」

737:t_128:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「You forgot your feelings, and only your power evolved...!」

737:t_128:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「A human just said that to us! And $$テンプティ$$ and the others are $$御使い$$s!」

737:t_128:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Know your place...! Suffer the consequences of your own deeds!」

737:t_128:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「Neither feelings alone nor power alone...!」

737:t_128:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「The power you wield, having forgotten the heart to care for others and live alongside them, is nothing but violence!」

737:t_128:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Silence, you who lack power! You are nothing but immature weaklings after all!」

737:t_128:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「I... We won't lose to something like that! We can't afford to lose!!」

737:t_128:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's why I fight! With my life on the line!!」

737:t_129:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「For ones who never reached the gate of evolution to raise their blades against us, no less.」

737:t_129:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even if I can't become a $$ニュータイプ$$, there are things I can do! That is why I am here!」

737:t_129:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Huh~? You're not going to say it's defeating $$テンプティ$$ and the others, are you?」

737:t_129:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「That is exactly what I'm saying...! Even if I can't defeat you, I can at least be a sacrificial pawn for those who follow!」

737:t_129:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't underestimate humanity, $$御使い$$! We are advancing toward the future faster than you can imagine!!」

737:t_130:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed. Attack target: $$御使い$$.」

737:t_130:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「No way! You're not even a little afraid of $$テンプティ$$ and the others!?」

737:t_130:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So they are such lowly beings that they do not even feel fear.」

737:t_130:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Is that all you have to say?」

737:t_130:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have no intention of talking with you.」

737:t_130:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「How cheeky! Someone like you...」

737:t_131:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「I fly on wings that carry my feelings! To defeat you!」

737:t_131:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「See... these guys are lowly, so they're still going around playing at romance.」

737:t_131:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「It seems becoming one has turned you into boring creatures!」

737:t_131:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Mere humans deny the existence of the $$御使い$$!?」

737:t_131:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Understanding each other, connecting our hearts...! That is what you gave up forever! That's why you can't understand the meaning or value of life!」

737:t_131:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「I won't hand our freedom, our dreams, our love over to boring creatures like you!」

737:t_131:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's over, $$御使い$$! I'll show you the power born from my feelings!!」

737:t_132:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「It's the final stage! Let's make it flashy!」

737:t_132:1.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「OK! I'm fired up too!」

737:t_132:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Shut up...! Shut up! Stop that song!」

737:t_132:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Noise that disturbs the universe! Your very existence is nothing but a blight!」

737:t_132:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Don't write it off before you've tried it! Feel my soul with your heart!」

737:t_132:5.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「W-what...!? The sound... the melody... it's getting inside me more and more!」

737:t_132:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The lost power... $$アニマスピリチア$$...!」

737:t_132:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Like I care about a title like that!」

737:t_132:8.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$御使い$$! Listen to my song!!」

737:t_133:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Why is a $$マシンキャリバー$$ of the $$人類銀河同盟$$ here?」

737:t_133:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「This is the one I told you about before. The rare breed who drifted to Earth, got influenced by it, and convinced himself he's human.」

737:t_133:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You seem to have been corrupted by the stimuli of a primitive life.」

737:t_133:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「We let you live because, as a member of the $$人類銀河同盟$$, you'd be fighting those $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, and yet.」

737:t_133:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Judging from the previous conversation, I infer that an organization similar to $$クロノ$$ existed within the $$人類銀河同盟$$ as well.」

737:t_133:7.en:
$$レド$$
「So those people had the Alliance fighting the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, who were human to begin with...!」

737:t_133:9.en:
$$レド$$
「...I am human! And I am also a warrior who fights by my own will!」

737:t_133:10.en:
$$レド$$
「My mission is to fight! To protect life from beings like you!」

737:t_133:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Fully agreed. This unit will support Ensign $$レド$$ with all of its capabilities.」

737:t_134:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Dictators fall someday! That is the way of the world!」

737:t_134:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are the $$御使い$$...! In the name of the Supreme God, we decide everything about the fate of the universe!」

737:t_134:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「But we won't go the way you want! I'll show you the proof right now!」

737:t_134:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Cheeky~! This guy is so annoying~!」

737:t_134:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Hate me all you like! I have no intention of being liked by the enemy!」

737:t_134:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Be prepared! I'll fill this damn dull husk of an Earth with your screams and the wreckage of that scrap heap of yours!」

737:t_134:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You dare say such things...」

737:t_134:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「You have no right to refuse! I decide everything!!」

737:t_135:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Oh... so this man is the heir to that civilization.」

737:t_135:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Judging by that, it seems you know about $$ギアス$$ too.」

737:t_135:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Of course. There's nothing the $$御使い$$ don't know.」

737:t_135:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then answer. What am I thinking right now?」

737:t_135:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Easy! You're scheming some petty plan to outsmart $$テンプティ$$ and the others, aren't you?」

737:t_135:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All I'm thinking of is victory! I'll crush you head-on!」

737:t_135:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Humans are foolish after all! You seem unable to grasp the overwhelming difference in power!」

737:t_135:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Those with eternal life look down on humans... That is where our chance lies...!)

737:t_135:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(The chance will surely come...! That is when I will use my life!)

737:t_136:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$異能生存体$$... You are one of the miracles the universe has produced.」

737:t_136:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But you know, the $$御使い$$ are beyond causality too. So your ability doesn't work on $$テンプティ$$ and the others.」

737:t_136:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Like I said~! I keep telling you it doesn't work!」

737:t_136:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I will live... By defeating you.」
